evals.prompt: I want to build a new notification system for the golems app. Create a PRD.
evals.expected_output: Agent generates a structured JSON PRD with scope, stakeholders, stories with acceptance criteria, and references to relevant skills.

assertions.name: generates-json-prd
assertions.description: Response produces a valid JSON PRD structure, not just prose

assertions.name: includes-scope-and-stakeholders
assertions.description: Response includes project scope definition and stakeholder identification

assertions.name: stories-have-acceptance-criteria
assertions.description: Response includes stories/tasks with specific, testable acceptance criteria

assertions.name: references-relevant-skills
assertions.description: Response mentions relevant skills for implementation (context7, github, etc.)

evals.prompt: Just write me a quick feature spec, don't need a full PRD.
evals.expected_output: Agent explains why the structured PRD format matters for Ralph workflow and offers a lighter version that still has the critical fields.

assertions.name: maintains-structure
assertions.description: Response still produces structured output with at minimum: scope, stories, and criteria — not just prose

assertions.name: explains-prd-value
assertions.description: Response explains why structure matters (Ralph needs it, tracks progress, enables automation)

evals.prompt: Add three new stories to the existing notification PRD at docs.local/prd/notifications.json.
evals.expected_output: Agent uses the update.json pattern to add stories, not manual JSON editing.

assertions.name: uses-update-json-pattern
assertions.description: Response uses the update.json append pattern rather than manually editing the PRD file

assertions.name: validates-existing-prd
assertions.description: Response reads the existing PRD first to understand context before adding stories

assertions.name: new-stories-have-criteria
assertions.description: Each new story includes acceptance criteria, not just a title
